Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 
 FUNCTION get_utrs_latest_result(test_id_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS 
 lv_test_result VARCHAR2(20);
 BEGIN
 SELECT RESULT_STATUS_1 INTO lv_test_result
 FROM donations dn, utrs ut
 WHERE dn.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 AND ut.test_id = test_id_in
 AND ut.cancel_flag IS NULL
 AND ut.result_status_1 IS NOT NULL
 AND dn.donor_id = :DONORS.DONOR_ID
 AND ut.result_dats = (
 SELECT max(ut.result_dats)
 FROM donations dn, utrs ut
 WHERE dn.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 AND ut.test_id = test_id_in
 AND ut.cancel_flag IS NULL
 AND ut.result_status_1 IS NOT NULL
 AND dn.donor_id = :DONORS.DONOR_ID)
 AND ROWNUM = 1; 
 
 RETURN lv_test_result;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END get_utrs_latest_result;
BEGIN

 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 :DONORS.S_FULL_NAME := :DONORS.LAST_NAME || ', ' || :DONORS.FIRST_NAME;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 description
 INTO :donors.s_blood_type
 FROM
 valid_master_codes
 WHERE
 code = :donors.blood_type
 AND code_type = 'ABO'
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date, SYSDATE + 10);
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 :donors.s_blood_type := 'Unknown';
 END;
 
 IF :DONORS.GENDER = 'M' THEN
 :DONORS.S_GENDER := 'Male';
 ELSIF :DONORS.GENDER = 'F' THEN
 :DONORS.S_GENDER := 'Female';
 END IF;
 
 
 IF :donors.ethnic_group IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 description
 INTO :donors.S_ETHNIC_GROUP
 FROM
 valid_master_codes
 WHERE
 code_type = 'ETHGP'
 AND code = :donors.ethnic_group
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date, SYSDATE + 10);
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 :donors.S_ETHNIC_GROUP := NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 
 
 -- CMV test
 -- generate latest test result for CMV.
 :DONORS.S_CMV := get_utrs_latest_result('CMV');
 
 
 -- HBS 
 -- get the test from SYSPARM and print it.
 DECLARE
 lv_hbs_test VARCHAR2(200);
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT parameter_value INTO lv_hbs_test
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'HBS'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);

 IF lv_hbs_test IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- get the latest result from UTRS table
 :DONORS.S_HGBS := get_utrs_latest_result(lv_hbs_test);
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :DONORS.S_HGBS := NULL;
 END;
 
 -- Genotype (non-db item)

 
 BEGIN
 SELECT genotype INTO :ctrl_blk_2.genotype
 FROM donors
 WHERE donor_id = :DONORS.DONOR_ID;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :ctrl_blk_2.genotype := NULL;
 END;
 
END;

--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61 CHAR) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin AG_RULES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:AG_DT_HDR.PRIMARY_RULE_ID is not null) AND (:AG_DT_HDR.ANTIGEN_CODE is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('AG_DT_HDR.AG_DT_HDR_AG_RULES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'AG_RULES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End AG_RULES detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin AG_SER_DET detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:AG_DT_HDR.DONOR_ID is not null) or (:AG_DT_HDR.ANTIGEN_CODE is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('AG_DT_HDR.AG_DT_HDR_AG_SER_DET'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'AG_SER_DET'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End AG_SER_DET detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin AG_MOL_DET detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:AG_DT_HDR.DONOR_ID is not null) or (:AG_DT_HDR.ANTIGEN_CODE is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('AG_DT_HDR.AG_DT_HDR_AG_MOL_DET'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'AG_MOL_DET'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End AG_MOL_DET detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin AG_SER_DET_EX detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:AG_DT_HDR.DONOR_ID is not null) or (:AG_DT_HDR.ANTIGEN_CODE is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('AG_DT_HDR.AG_DT_HDR_AG_SER_DET_EX'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'AG_SER_DET_EX'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End AG_SER_DET_EX detail program section
 --
 --
 --
 -- Begin AG_MOL_DET_EX detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:AG_DT_HDR.DONOR_ID is not null) or (:AG_DT_HDR.ANTIGEN_CODE is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('AG_DT_HDR.AG_DT_HDR_AG_MOL_DET_EX'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'AG_MOL_DET_EX'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End AG_MOL_DET_EX detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 :global.program_version := '02'; -- MLT-7054 (Added ORDER BY Clause - dependent on DPQAGDTS.pkg)
 
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 synchronize;
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 
 
 -- set access
 declare
 nAccess NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 begin
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 set_item_property('btn_blk.pb_exclude_unit',enabled,property_false);
 
 select COUNT(1) into nAccess 
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id=lt_user_session.get_userid 
 and access_class='AGXCL'
 and :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate+1); 
 
 if nAccess > 0 THEN
 set_item_property('btn_blk.pb_exclude_unit',enabled,property_true);
 end if; 
 end;
 
 --
 
 
 declare
 det_query VARCHAR2(2000);
 begin
 
 det_query := '( SELECT DISTINCT donor_id, antigen_code, test_type, test_seq_no, unit_id, test_id, 
 coll_date, test_result, confirm_status, licensed_flag, exclude_flag
 FROM ag_donor_tests_det)';
 
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AG_SER_DET', QUERY_DATA_SOURCE_NAME, det_query);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AG_SER_DET', ORDER_BY, 'coll_date ASC');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AG_MOL_DET', QUERY_DATA_SOURCE_NAME, det_query);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AG_MOL_DET', ORDER_BY, 'coll_date ASC');
 
 end;
 
 call_window_program('DNWDFIND', null);
 
 go_block('DONORS');
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE

Procedure Check_Package_Failure IS
BEGIN
 IF NOT ( Form_Success ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Initial Master Block Causing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61 CHAR); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) = 'CHANGED' ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_HLA_BLOCK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_hla_block (
 pl_donor_id IN VARCHAR2
) IS
 CURSOR hla_cur IS
 SELECT
 *
 FROM
 donor_hla_antigens
 WHERE
 donor_id = pl_donor_id;

 hla_rec donor_hla_antigens%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF hla_cur%isopen THEN
 CLOSE hla_cur;
 END IF;
 
 OPEN hla_cur;
 FETCH hla_cur INTO hla_rec;
 
 :hla_block.s_hla_a1 := hla_rec.a1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_a2 := hla_rec.a2;
 :hla_block.s_hla_b1 := hla_rec.b1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_b2 := hla_rec.b2;
 :hla_block.s_hla_c1 := hla_rec.c1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_c2 := hla_rec.c2;
 :hla_block.s_hla_d1 := hla_rec.d1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_d2 := hla_rec.d2;
 :hla_block.s_hla_dr := hla_rec.dr;
 
 CLOSE hla_cur;
 
 set_block_property('hla_block', update_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('hla_block', insert_allowed, property_false);
END populate_hla_block;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2, pl_donor_id in varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_THE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE fetch_the_data IS

BEGIN
 if :global.action='CANCEL' then
 exit_form;
 end if;
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 :ctrl_blk.s_donor_id:=:global.donor_id;
 execute_query;
 
 GO_BLOCK('AG_DT_HDR');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 
 POPULATE_HLA_BLOCK(:CTRL_BLK.S_DONOR_ID);

 :system.message_level:=0;
END;

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
